description: enforce_for_delivery checks the in-memory cache before performing any DNS or HTTPS I/O. This design: (1) makes the enforcer unit-testable without live DNS (seed_cache test helper), (2) prevents test hangs, (3) reduces latency on hot paths. A future contributor might suggest 'always revalidate against DNS' — resist this. RFC 8461 §4.2 explicitly says to cache and use the cached policy. The cache-first approach is both correct and necessary for test isolation.
title: cache-first design in MtaStsEnforcer prevents DNS hangs in tests
